facts.name: Mastercard
sentences: Mastercard's shares moved 5% or more on 1 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 13 November 2026, when the stock rose 1.3%.
The stock is up 15.9% this year, and at $661.71 it sits 1.6% below its 52-week closing high of $672.68 from 4 November 2026.
$1,000 invested in Mastercard five years ago would be worth $1,791 today.
